description: DNS lookup for a website's domain: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and CAA records, via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS. Pass a URL or bare hostname. Fast (under 2 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: dns
title: DNS lookup for a website's domain
